terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of mikrouli. By creating a short link, you accept them.
terms.lawfulUse: You may create short links only for destinations you are authorised to point to and that are lawful in the jurisdictions where they are created and accessed. You must not use mikrouli to facilitate unlawful content or conduct.
terms.userResponsibility: You bear sole responsibility for the content your short links point to. mikrouli only redirects visitors to a destination you chose; it does not host, endorse, review, or curate the linked content.
terms.operatorDisclaimer: The operator of mikrouli disclaims all liability for the destinations users point their short links to. The operator does not verify, monitor, or screen user-created link destinations and is not responsible for their content, availability, or accuracy.
terms.linkRetention: Short links are not guaranteed to be retained indefinitely. The retention period of created short links may change at any time and is not guaranteed; a link may stop resolving without prior notice.
terms.contact: For questions about these terms, contact support@mikrou.li.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes how mikrouli handles data when you use the service.
privacy.dataCollected: Account and link data is stored in PostgreSQL. Slug-to-destination mappings are cached in Redis on the redirect hot path. Authentication uses signed JWT tokens.
privacy.analytics: Click events on the redirect hot path are recorded fire-and-forget into ClickHouse to power dashboard analytics. The recorded data covers clicks on short links, not the content of linked destinations.
privacy.retention: Click analytics are retained for the operational lifetime of the service unless the retention period is revised. Short-link retention is not guaranteed (see the Terms of Service).
privacy.contact: For privacy questions or data requests, contact support@mikrou.li.
